# Casper SDKs

> Developer documentation for the Casper SDKs: the JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (per page, plus its changelog and guides), the .NET SDK articles, the Go SDK and its packages, the Rust/WebAssembly SDK, the Java SDK, and the Casper Wallet SDK for connecting dApps to the Casper Wallet extension. Only documentation for released versions is included.

Each link fetches the page's raw markdown; the URL after the colon is where it is published.
Generated by https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms from casper-ecosystem/casper-js-sdk@635dd64, casper-ecosystem/casper-rust-wasm-sdk@4263e47, casper-network/casper-java-sdk@5e11704, make-software/casper-go-sdk@ca6c88f, make-software/casper-net-sdk@295d2f5, make-software/casper-net-sdk@bea0271, make-software/casper-wallet-sdk@250dbd1.
